metaTitle: Mothball: put idle projects away, get your disk back
metaDescription: Mothball finds the build output in projects you have not touched in months, puts it away, and rebuilds it when you come back. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.
ogDescription: Finds the build output in projects you forgot, puts it away, and rebuilds it when you come back. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.
ogImageAlt: Mothball: your disk is full of projects you forgot. 56.5 GB back on the first run.
eyebrow: free · open source · Mac, Windows, Linux
lede: Mothball finds the build output in projects you have not touched in months, puts it away, and rebuilds it the day you come back. Your code stays exactly where it is.

meterCaption: The first run, on the Mac Mothball was built on

stat1: stacks it understands, from JavaScript and Flutter to Rust, Unity and Terraform.

howTitle: It sits in your menu bar and keeps the shelf tidy.
step1: It reads each project's own files to know its stack, then measures the build output that can be regenerated. Projects you touched recently are left alone.
step2: One click, or let Autopilot do it whenever free space drops below your target. The longest idle projects go first.
step3: Open an old project again and Mothball notices. Wake runs the right restore step for its stack:
safeTitle: All of this is safe to put away.
safeBody: Every folder here can be rebuilt with one command. Mothball only takes it when the project around it proves what it is.
chipsNote: 22 stacks, plus app and tool caches in green. Never bookmarks, sign-ins or messages.
safetyBody: A cleaner you are scared of is a cleaner you never use. Mothball would rather skip a folder than guess.
rule1b: If it is committed, it is yours.
rule2: Never matches by folder name alone.
rule2b: A folder called build is only build output when the project around it says so.
rule3b: Projects with changes in progress are skipped.
rule4b: If anything changed since the scan, it backs off.
rule5b: Every move is logged, and .mothballignore keeps anything you choose.
cliTitle: The whole thing is a CLI too.
cliBody: Same engine, same safety checks, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
termLabel: Example terminal session: mothball scan finds 6 idle projects with 19.3 GB of build output, mothball clean puts it away, and mothball wake restores a project.
dlDefault: Free and open source, for macOS, Windows and Linux.
allDownloadsBody: macOS, Windows and Linux, on the GitHub releases page.
appIncludesCli: The app includes the mothball command line tool.
ctaTitle: Your old projects can rest. Your disk can breathe.
licence: Free and open source under the MIT licence.
footFine: No cookies. This site counts visits and downloads anonymously.
macFits: One download for every Mac: Apple silicon (M1 to M4) and Intel. macOS 11 or later. Signed and notarised.
winX64Fits: Most Windows PCs: Intel and AMD processors. Windows 10 and 11. Installs for your account, no admin prompt.
winArmFits: Snapdragon laptops and Surface Pro with an Arm chip. Runs natively, not emulated.
linuxX64Fits: AppImage for any distro: Intel and AMD desktops and laptops. Make it executable and run it; it updates itself.
linuxArmFits: AppImage for Arm laptops, Raspberry Pi 4 and 5 on a 64-bit OS, and Arm desktops.
scoopNote: The installer also adds the mothball command. Not sure which one? Settings > System > About > System type. If SmartScreen warns you, choose More info, then Run anyway.
packageNote: The .deb and .rpm (x64 and Arm64) are on the release page. Each adds Mothball to your app menu and the mothball command to your terminal.
pickedFor: We picked {os} for you. Not right? Choose another.
suggest: This page is also in English.
appsTitle: The apps you use every day keep gigabytes of cache.
appsBody: Browsers, chat apps and editors save copies of pages and files they can fetch again whenever they need them. On a typical work laptop that adds up to a few gigabytes. Mothball clears those copies, and each app rebuilds what it needs the next time you open it.
appsClears: Page caches, cached app files and downloaded extension packages.
appsNever: Bookmarks, history, passwords, sign-ins, messages, chats and downloads stay exactly where they are.
appsWaitTitle: Waits while an app is open.
appsWait: Mothball tells you which app it is waiting for, and leaves its cache alone until you close it.
